projects.title: Modern Minimal Residence
projects.shortDescription: A serene urban retreat characterized by continuous microcement textures and monolithic travertine accents.
projects.description: A serene urban retreat characterized by continuous microcement textures, concealed architectural doors, and monolithic travertine accents. Designed for seamless everyday comfort with bespoke concealed storage and ambient cove lighting.

projects.title: Contemporary Family Home
projects.shortDescription: Generous multi-generational spatial planning integrating double-volume lightwells and custom walnut millwork.
projects.description: Generous multi-generational spatial planning integrating double-volume lightwells, custom walnut millwork, and private landscaped courtyard views. Every floor features customized joinery engineered in our direct Singapore factory.

projects.title: Warm Japandi Interior
projects.shortDescription: Harmonious interplay of pale oak, natural lime-wash wall finishes, and tatami-inspired platform storage.
projects.description: Harmonious interplay of pale oak, natural lime-wash wall finishes, tatami-inspired platform storage, and gentle ambient cove lighting. Complete spatial reconfiguration transforming standard BTO compartments into an expansive open gallery.

projects.title: Luxury Urban Residence
projects.shortDescription: Rich dark walnut finishes, bookmatched Italian Statuario marble, and temperature-controlled wine displays.
projects.description: Rich dark walnut finishes, bookmatched Italian Statuario marble, brushed bronze hardware, and temperature-controlled custom wine displays. Crafted with discreet luxury details and integrated smart-home automation.

projects.title: Refined Waterfront Penthouse
projects.shortDescription: Sweeping sea views echoed through light travertine floors and organic curvature in ceiling coves.
projects.description: Sweeping sea views echoed through light travertine floors, organic curvature in ceiling coves, and bespoke floating cabinetry. Uncompromising materiality crafted to withstand coastal humidity.

projects.title: Heritage Resale Reinvention
projects.shortDescription: Full gut renovation merging compartmentalized rooms into a panoramic open-concept living gallery.
projects.description: Full gut renovation merging two compartmentalized rooms into a panoramic open-concept living gallery with restored terrazzo sensibilities and custom micro-fluted oak partitions.

projects.title: Atelier & Commercial Loft
projects.shortDescription: Modular timber acoustic pods, integrated presentation walls, and a welcoming hospitality bar.
projects.description: Modular timber acoustic pods, integrated presentation walls, and a welcoming hospitality bar designed for client gatherings and creative collaboration.

projects.title: Coronation Sanctuary
projects.shortDescription: Monolithic stone islands, concealed automated glass sliders, and tranquil water feature vistas.
projects.description: A masterclass in indoor-outdoor fluidity featuring monolithic stone islands, concealed automated glass sliders, and tranquil water feature vistas. Designed for multi-generational living.
